minor.issue: Test-only flake (not a real backend bug). Module-scoped cx httpx.Client accumulates cookies from earlier register/login tests (which set bo_token cookie post iter72). /auth/me then sees a valid cookie and returns 200 instead of 401. Real endpoint works correctly (curl returns 401). Fix: make cx function-scoped OR call cx.cookies.clear() at start of test_auth_me_requires_token.

action_items: IMPORTANT operational note: CRA dev server (yarn start managed by supervisor) does NOT hot-reload changes to /app/frontend/public/index.html. On initial verification the served index.html was stale (still pointed og:image at /icon-512.png with no ?v=10). I ran `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` which picked up the new template — after restart all tests pass. Main agent should note: future edits to public/index.html require a frontend restart, and the deployed build (yarn build → /app/frontend/build/index.html) already contains the correct tags.

Optional cleanup: change `cx` fixture in test_auth_deep_investigation.py from scope='module' to scope='function' (or call cx.cookies.clear() inside the two auth_me_requires_token/bad_token tests) so the new cookie-auth from iter72 doesn't leak between tests.

rca of the issue: P0 root cause exactly as main agent diagnosed: raster PNGs at /app/frontend/public were dated Aug 27 (pre-rebrand) while only logo-mark.svg had been updated to the BlueOcean shopping-bag design. All social preview surfaces, browser tabs, PWA install icons, iOS home-screen icons render the raster PNGs — hence the old logo appeared everywhere. Fix (cairosvg regeneration + manifest.json refresh + index.html og:image bump to icon-1024.png?v=10 + service-worker v11 cache-key bump) is complete and verified. Small operational discovery during verification: the CRA dev server does not hot-reload public/index.html changes — a `supervisorctl restart frontend` was required to pick up the new meta tags, but the built (production-served) /app/frontend/build/index.html was already correct.
